ideas.pitch: A robust background service that automates scheduled, resumable SP-API getFulfillmentPreview collection to build a weekly comparable SKU x pincode history matrix.
ideas.problem_statement: Automated, scheduled, resumable gathering of delivery-promise data via the Amazon SP-API and a queryable store holding history for week-over-week comparison.
ideas.title: SP-API Resumable Data Pipeline and Historical Matrix Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the core data collection requirement directly with fault tolerance, resembling a production-grade data engineering pipeline that judges immediately value for reliability.

ideas.pitch: An analytics layer and interactive dashboard computing delivery promise by cluster, SKU, and category with automated root-cause separation for supply chain managers.
ideas.problem_statement: Analytics: Promise by cluster, SKU and category; trend detection; root-cause separation; Interface: A dashboard readable by a supply chain manager in seconds.
ideas.title: Supply Chain Promise Analytics & Trend Detection Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an immediate, polished visual interface that answers the exact business metrics the sponsor cares about in under a minute.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight verification tool that computes the quantifiable gap between the backend SP-API reported delivery promise and live storefront expectations.
ideas.problem_statement: Calibration: A method for quantifying the gap between the API-reported promise and the live storefront promise.
ideas.title: Storefront vs. API Promise Calibration Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an advanced edge-case requirement from the prompt scope that most competing teams will skip, showing rigorous attention to detail.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous event-driven alerting system that detects when a regional fulfillment cluster degrades materially and dispatches structured root-cause diagnostic summaries.
ideas.problem_statement: Alerting: Notification when a cluster degrades materially, alongside trend detection and root-cause separation.
ideas.title: Cluster Degradation Alerting & Incident Response Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines real-time threshold monitoring with actionable agentic insights, mirroring winning patterns from top data and reliability hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A data lineage and validation wrapper for SP-API payloads that tracks every transformation step from inventory placement decisions to final delivery promise matrices.
ideas.problem_statement: Collection, storage, and analytics pipeline closing the loop between stock placement decisions and continuous delivery promise measurement at pincode granularity.
ideas.title: Plantex SP-API End-to-End Compliance and Lineage Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses advanced data lineage principles to prove data integrity and provenance, matching the exact criteria that win competitive data engineering hackathons.
